Requirements Your Noble Blood combo opening and Reign of Beasts. Make a melee gunblade Strike with 4d6 additional slashing damage. On a hit, up to two other enemies both within your reach and adjacent to the target each take 4d6 fire damage with a basic Reflex save against your class DC. Secondary damage is not doubled by a critical hit on the primary Strike.

You may use only one Reign sequence action per turn. End the sequence. This does not grant Continuation.

Additional Strike damage @Damage[4d6[slashing]]; secondary @Damage[4d6[fire]] — @Check[type:reflex|against:gunbreaker|basic:true]
